name: Exact match on held-out AL syntax cases
purpose: Measure exact output agreement on a versioned held-out syntax corpus.
definition: Fraction of evaluated cases whose normalized output exactly matches the reference output.

formula.method: Count exact matches then divide by all eligible evaluated cases.

variables.meaning: Number of cases matching the reference exactly

population.inclusion: Cases with a valid reference output and deterministic evaluation.
population.exclusion: Malformed or disputed reference cases excluded before evaluation.
population.sampling_method: Stratified by syntax feature and error class.

measurement_protocol.procedure: Run the pinned compiler build against each held-out case and compare normalized outputs.
measurement_protocol.conditions: Same compiler flags and fixture corpus; no network access.

uncertainty.method: Report Wilson confidence interval for a binomial proportion.
uncertainty.limitations: Confidence interval does not capture corpus representativeness.

threshold.rationale: No approved evidence-based release threshold has been established.
